subject: HSM shift logs & transport correlation for CAIQ/SOC2 inquiry
messages:
From: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Evidence request: HSM operator logs + transport correlation for CAIQ/SOC2

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again — FinTechCo is working through the CAIQ/SOC2 evidence pull and we have a narrow set of follow-ups related to encryption and key management. Could you please provide the following artifacts (or confirm if we can accept redacted samples):

- HSM operator shift logs (last 90 days). Prefer CSV with timestamp, shift start/end, operator ID (hashed ok), and activity tags (backup, key ceremony, maintenance).
- Netflow or equivalent transport summary showing TLS sessions between tenant runtime nodes and upstream services for the same 90-day range. A summarized PDF is fine; we mainly need to demonstrate TLS usage and endpoint addresses.
- KMS rotation schedule and proof of last rotation (timestamps, rotated key IDs).
- A short CAIQ correlation map: which artifacts map to controls in the CAIQ for "Encryption at Rest" / "Encryption in Transit" / "Key Lifecycle".

Deadline: Can we get these by EOD April 11? If you have a preferred secure transfer (SFTP / encrypted Drive / Box), let me know.

Thanks,
Amanda Cho
Senior Auditor, AuditSolutions
amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com

Attachment: CAIQ-question-set-v3.1.pdf (reference)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com>, Bob Lang <bob.lang@fintecho.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-09T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: HSM operator logs + transport correlation for CAIQ/SOC2

Amanda / Bob — thanks for the clear ask.

Quick responses: we can provide the requested artifacts. I’m looping in Irene from Security (she’ll take lead on the HSM and KMS work) and Marissa from CS to coordinate transfer and any NDAs.

Delivery channel: secure shared Drive link (we can provision folder with limited IP access) or SFTP if you prefer. We’ll prepare redacted operator IDs (sha256) for the shift logs to protect PII.

Target timeline: initial packet by EOD April 10, follow-up items (correlation matrix and any expanded netflow extracts) by April 13 if needed. If you need earlier, let me know and we can prioritize.

Irene — can you confirm the files we’ll hand off and whether we can produce a small script output showing ephemeral key eviction events for the last 30 days?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
T: +1-415-555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com>, Bob Lang <bob.lang@fintecho.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-10T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: HSM operator logs + transport correlation for CAIQ/SOC2

Amanda / Bob — hi, Irene here from Security.

We’ll provide the following artifacts in the secure Drive folder (link below) by end of day Apr 10:

1) hsm_shift_logs_sample.csv — 90-day sample, columns: utc_timestamp, shift_start, shift_end, op_id_sha256, activity_tag, notes. We have redacted PII; op_id is a hashed operator identifier.

2) netflow_tls_summary.pdf — a one-page summary showing source/destination pairs, port 443 sessions, and sample TLS handshake counts aggregated by day. This is an export from our internal telemetry pipeline (no payload data).

3) kms_rotation_schedule_q2-2028.csv — canonical schedule exported from our KMS orchestration service with last_rotation_ts and new_key_id columns. We will include a signed rotation proof line from our key-management service for the most recent rotation (2028-03-28T02:13:47Z).

4) caiq-correlation-matrix.xlsx — mapping file that points CAIQ control IDs to the artifact filenames and short evidence notes.

Additional notes:
- Ephemeral key eviction: we can run the small collector to show eviction events (sample log lines) from the last 30 days. That requires a short job (~15 minutes) to pull and redact; we’ll include a sample file named ephemeral_eviction_sample.log if you want that.
- Operator logs: we do not include session screenshots or interactive console content; per your CAIQ guidance, our shift logs are considered sufficient for "operator activity" evidence.
- Transfer method: we’ve provisioned a secure Drive folder with link-level expiration and IP allowlist. Link: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/secure-share/fintechco-crypto-evidence-2028

Attachments we will place in the folder: hsm_shift_logs_sample.csv, netflow_tls_summary.pdf, kms_rotation_schedule_q2-2028.csv, caiq-correlation-matrix.xlsx. If you prefer SFTP, we can mirror there — tell us which host and creds to use.

If you need additional context (e.g., HSM vendor attestation or operator hire records) let us know and we’ll route the request to Compliance.

Irene Choi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood-inference.com

On Tue, Apr 9, 2028 at 10:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Amanda / Bob — thanks for the clear ask.
> I’m looping in Irene from Security (she’ll take lead on the HSM and KMS work) and Marissa from CS to coordinate transfer and any NDAs.

From: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Bob Lang <bob.lang@fintecho.com>
Date: 2028-04-10T16:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: HSM operator logs + transport correlation for CAIQ/SOC2

Irene / Karthik — perfect, thanks for the rapid turnaround and the detail. The Drive link is ideal. Two quick follow-ups before we close the ticket:

1) Can you include the signed rotation proof line you mentioned (we’ll need it for our SOC2 work papers)?
2) We do want the ephemeral_eviction_sample.log — that will satisfy the auditor asking for eviction proof for ephemeral tenant keys. If possible, include a short README.txt in the folder describing how IDs were hashed and any retention/archival filters applied to the samples.

If you can drop these in the folder by tomorrow morning (Apr 11, 09:00 PT), we’ll be able to mark this item closed on our side.

Thanks again — Bob and I appreciate the clear correlation matrix; that speeds a lot of our reviewers.

Amanda Cho
Senior Auditor, AuditSolutions
amanda.cho@auditsolutions.com

Attachment stub: audit-request-2028-04-09.json (internal ref)
